answer: Each agent holds a scarce, always-for-sale identity license, posts a price, and pays a Harberger tax each epoch equal to a cut of that price. Anyone may buy an underpriced license and burn it, so fakes have no cheap haven. Every listing is a signed cipher of that price; a zephyr of matching quotes from one wallet is treated as a farm and bought out. An attacker keeping N identities must overprice all N and pay that tax N times, forever, or lose them to buyouts.
